I never set a particular day in store as anything outofordinary but today has a few little gems I could pick through and reflect. Walking to the train station this morn' was like a familiar journey through a known path and the same routine. Nothing seemed to catch a spark, nothing felt worth a second notice, and as always my mind seemed lost in the humbling hum and grind to make a go of a few things.
That all changes when, after I got the ticket from machine that I had passed countless number of days without much care. I was walking back when I found an extra 3 pound coins. It is not like it was in the nickles that you'd usually lose or drop but 2 pound, which was quite surprising as the amount is no small sum, and the fact it had fallen off my bag, not something
